```{r}
# Using R
# Option 1: tidytuesdayR R package 
## install.packages("tidytuesdayR")

# Option 2: Read directly from GitHub

ikea_places <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-10-27/ikea_places.csv')
ikea_seating <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-10-27/ikea_seating.csv')
```

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, mosaic, rio, car, pander, dplyr)
```

```{r}
most_countries <- ikea_seating %>%
  group_by(product_name) %>%
  summarize(country = n()) %>%
  filter(country > 500)

least_countries <- ikea_seating %>%
  group_by(product_name) %>%
  summarize(country = n()) %>%
  filter(country < 3)

```

```{r}
ggplot(most_countries, aes(x = product_name, y = country)) +
  geom_col()
```

```{r}
ggplot(least_countries, aes(x = product_name, y = country)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 4)
  )
```
